horizontalvertical/horizontalvertical8.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while replacing the differently colored shapes at the top and the bottom of the green shape with black pixels.

horizontalvertical/horizontalvertical9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while coloring vertical lines with yellow pixels and coloring horizontal lines with orange pixels.

insideoutside/insideoutside1.rule: Produce a grid of black pixels with width 1 and height equal to the amount of colored pixels outside of the colored rectangle shape.

insideoutside/insideoutside10.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while replacing the pixels that are overshadowing a background shape with the color of that shape. In addition, replace all pixels that are outside of the shape with black pixels.

insideoutside/insideoutside11.rule: Render the selected count as stripes after selecting the objects inside the dominant-color boundary hull from parallel lines with dots between and outside them.

insideoutside/insideoutside12.rule: Keep only the selected object group on the same canvas after selecting the objects outside the largest container object from nested containers with inside, between, and outside objects.

insideoutside/insideoutside13.rule: Render the selected count as a colored bar after selecting the objects outside the dominant-color open hull from an irregular dominant-color outline with inside and outside dots.

insideoutside/insideoutside14.rule: Keep only the selected object group on the same canvas after selecting the objects outside the largest container object from a sparse outline with one marker.

insideoutside/insideoutside15.rule: Recolor the selected object group after selecting the objects outside the largest container object from nested containers with inside, between, and outside objects.

insideoutside/insideoutside2.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing the yellow pixel if it is not between the two red pixels and removing the two red pixels otherwise. Between may be interpreted as laying on a line that connects the two red pixels.

insideoutside/insideoutside3.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing the yellow pixel if it is outside the shape outlined with red pixels or instead removing the red pixels if the yellow pixel is inside of the outlined shape.

insideoutside/insideoutside4.rule: Reproduce the gird completely, while removing the singular magenta pixel if it is outside of the innermost shape. If the magenta pixel is inside the innermost shape it is not removed. Innermost refers to the shape that is contained inside antother shape.

insideoutside/insideoutside5.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting all shapes that are not fully contained within another shape.

insideoutside/insideoutside6.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting all pixels that are contained within the singular different colored shape, which may feature small gaps, as well as the shape itself.

insideoutside/insideoutside7.rule: Produce a grid with hight of 1 and width of 1 pixel for every pixel contained fully within the two rectangle shapes from left to right, with the color of the surrounding rectangle.

insideoutside/insideoutside8.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting all pixels that are not contained in the open shape. Containment is fulfilled if at least three directions contain a pixel that belongs to the shape before reaching the grid border.

insideoutside/insideoutside9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting all yellow pixels that are not between two red lines, Between means that, when going in the four main directions, at least twice a red pixel that is part of a line will be met prior the grid border.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary1.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting all blue pixels toward the red line until one of them is directly adjacent to a red pixel.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary10.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the right shape to the right edge of the grid, until one of the pixels touches the right boundary. The shape may also be dashed instead of solid.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary11.rule: Translate the selected object toward the bottom edge until blocked after selecting the object centered on the grid center from a hollow object with distractors.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary12.rule: Translate the selected object toward the left edge until blocked after selecting the topmost object from aligned objects separated by a vertical gap.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary13.rule: Translate the selected object to touch the reference line after selecting the unique object other than the spanning reference line from one varied connected object separated from a horizontal or vertical reference line.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary14.rule: Translate the selected object toward the right edge until blocked after selecting the smallest marker from one colored marker cell on an empty grid.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary15.rule: translate the selected object in the nearest cardinal direction until it touches another object after selecting the object nearest the largest object's center from two differently sized filled or hollow objects aligned across a gap.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary2.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting all pixels into the main direction of the orange shapes, meaning to the right edge if they are horizontal and to the bottom if they are vertical. Pixels should only be shifted until they encounter the edge or another colored pixel.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary3.rule: Reproduce the gird completely, while shifting all pixels to the right until at least one pixel of every connected shape touches the right grid boundary. Do not shift pixels over each other.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary4.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting all pixels to the left, until at least one pixel of every connected shape touches the left grid boundary. Do not shift pixels over each other.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary5.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting all shapes to the edge that the line that meets another line in the middle points towards.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary6.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the singular pixel to the top edge if the long line is oriented vertically, or shifting the singular pixel to the right edge if the long line is oriented horizontically.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary7.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the smaller shape into the direction of the larger shape, until at least one pixel from the smaller shape is adjacent to a pixel of the larger shape.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary8.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the dashed line towards the solid line in the direction of the dashed pixels until at least one pixel is directly adjacent to the pixels of the solid line.

movetoboundary/movetoboundary9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the right shape to the right edge of the grid, until one of the pixels touches the right boundary. The shape may also be dashed instead of solid.

order/order1.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering rectangles according to their size from smallest to largest. Ordering should happen according to the primary axis in the input, e.g left to right or top to bottom.

order/order10.rule: Produce a grid with height 1 and one colored pixel per color contained in the input grid ordered by outermost to innermost shape.

order/order11.rule: remove a shared marker and reorder equal payloads ascending by marker height after selecting the equal panel bodies carrying embedded or external height markers from equal aligned monochrome payload panels decorated by distinct heights of one shared marker color.

order/order12.rule: stack objects ascending by occupied area from the bottom left toward right after selecting the all distinct-color members of a corner stack from distinct-color, same-type shapes of strictly increasing widths, using square or shared-height bounding boxes and stacked contiguously from the bottom-left corner toward right.

order/order13.rule: orient lines horizontal and pack them descending from the top right after selecting the connected objects from scattered straight lines with distinct lengths and orientations.

order/order14.rule: overlay nested-layer colors in inside-out order on a horizontal input-grid boundary after selecting the all nested color regions ordered from outside to inside from three to seven distinct monochrome rectangular or diamond layers nested around a common center.

order/order15.rule: stack objects ascending by occupied area from the top right toward down after selecting the all distinct-color members of a corner stack from distinct-color, same-type shapes of strictly increasing widths, using square or shared-height bounding boxes and stacked contiguously from the top-right corner toward down.

order/order2.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering lines according to their size, small to large vertical length, at the bottom left of the grid. Ties can be broken randomly.

order/order3.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering shapes according to the amount of differently colored pixels contained within the shapes, in small to large manner.

order/order4.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering shapes according to the vertical position or reach of the single pixels or smaller shapes contained within or adjacent to the colored rectangles or lines. Ordering should be lowest to highest, and the ordering indicators should be removed if adjacent or filled in if contained within the shape.

order/order5.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering the boxes within green lines according to the amount of yellow pixels they contain, in a few to most manner.

order/order6.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering rectangles according to their shapes from smallest to largest. Ordering should happen according to the primary axis in the input, e.g left to right or top to bottom.

order/order7.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering the left and right boxes separated by a grey line according to the amount of yellow rectangles they feature, in a less to more manner.

order/order8.rule: Produce a grid with height 1 and one colored pixel per color contained in the input grid from top to bottom.

order/order9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while re-ordering the green rectangles according to their size in a smallest to largest manner from bottom to top, while maintaining black lines as separators between them.

samedifferent/samedifferent1.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes that are not contained at least twice.

samedifferent/samedifferent10.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing the contents of the right side of the grey boundary line if the contents are not equal to the left side.

samedifferent/samedifferent11.rule: Recolor the selected object group after selecting the objects in repeated shape classes from filled multicolor bodies whose embedded objects form repeated and singleton shape classes.

samedifferent/samedifferent12.rule: Recolor the selected object group after selecting the objects in singleton color classes from separated differently shaped objects with repeated and singleton colors.

samedifferent/samedifferent13.rule: Remove the selected object group after selecting the objects in repeated shape classes from separated differently colored objects with repeated and singleton shapes.

samedifferent/samedifferent14.rule: Remove the selected object group after selecting the contained objects in repeated color classes from separate enclosures whose fully filled interiors form repeated and singleton color classes.

samedifferent/samedifferent15.rule: Recolor the selected object group after selecting the enclosed composite objects in singleton outer/inner color-signature classes from varied fully filled or empty enclosures whose outer/inner color signatures form repeated and singleton classes.

samedifferent/samedifferent2.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes that are not contained at least twice.

samedifferent/samedifferent3.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes whose colors are not contained at least twice.

samedifferent/samedifferent4.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes whose primary direction (e.g vertical, diagonal, horizontal) is not contained at least twice.

samedifferent/samedifferent5.rule: Produce a single pixel of the color that is inside of at least two shapes.

samedifferent/samedifferent6.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes whose colors are contained at least twice. If the shapes are filled with a different color this should be removed as well, and not be seen as an independent shape.

samedifferent/samedifferent7.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing all shapes that are not contained at least twice, where inner shapes are to be treated as standalone.

samedifferent/samedifferent8.rule: Produce the shape that is contained in both colored rectangles separated by a black line in a minimal bounding box. The contained shape may also be black. If there is no such shape, produce a singular black pixel.

samedifferent/samedifferent9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while coloring the contained shapes in cyan if they are equal and in grey if the shapes are not equal.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d1.rule: Produce the highest of the contained shapes in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d10.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while switching the uppermost and lowermost contained shapes.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d11.rule: Recolor the selected object after selecting the bottommost object from two to five same-family scattered objects with varied shared or distinct colors and unique topmost and bottommost objects.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d12.rule: Remove the selected object after selecting the topmost object preserving enclosed interior colors from two to four distinct-color objects from one shared geometric family with unique topmost and bottommost members.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d13.rule: swap the first and last objects of an axis-separated sequence while preserving middle-object order after selecting the all objects occupying separated bands along one axis from two to seven same-type monochrome objects aligned from top to bottom.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d14.rule: Recolor the selected object group after selecting the the topmost and bottommost objects from two to seven same-type monochrome objects aligned from top to bottom.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d15.rule: Keep only the selected object on the same canvas after selecting the object with the topmost bounding-box center from two to five densely packed same-family objects with unique top and bottom bounding-box centers.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d2.rule: Produce the lowest of the contained shapes in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d3.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while coloring the top horizontal line of the contained shape with red pixels.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d4.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while removing the shapes at the very top and the very bottom of the grid.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d5.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting all but the lowest contained shape.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d6.rule: Produce the lowest contained shape in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d7.rule: Produce the highest contained shape in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d8.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while coloring all contained shapes in the color of the lowest contained shape.

topbottom2d/topbottom2d9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while coloring the highest contained shape grey.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d1.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while switching the color of overlapping segments (e.g color in front switches to color in back).

topbottom3d/topbottom3d10.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while moving the shape that is currently in the front to the back, meaning that all overlapping pixels are recolored in favor of the background shape.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d11.rule: Render a colored cell patch alone at its original position after selecting the the complete inferred footprint of a periodic barred rectangle from a large periodic barred rectangle visibly interrupted by one complete solid or two-color framed rectangle.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d12.rule: reverse every visible shape-layer precedence relation after selecting the filled rectangle and straight-bar instances reconstructed through occlusion from parallel vertical bars distributed below and above perpendicular bars.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d13.rule: remove selected semantic layers and reveal layers below them after selecting the the unique top layer of a reconstructable basic-shape stack from two equal-size filled rectangles in a clear partial occlusion that leaves visible fill evidence, with enough margin to move either layer.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d14.rule: recolor selected semantic layers without changing their depth after selecting the the unique top layer of a reconstructable basic-shape stack from two equal-size filled rectangles in a clear partial occlusion that leaves visible fill evidence, with enough margin to move either layer.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d15.rule: remove selected lower layers while preserving foreground shapes after selecting the occluded horizontal rectangle and bar layers from parallel horizontal bars distributed below and above perpendicular bars.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d2.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting those shapes which are overlapped by a horizontal line.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d3.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while deleting those shapes which overlap a background shape. The pixels that were previously overlapped should be colored in line with the background shape.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d4.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while shifting the shape that overlaps another one to the left by one pixel.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d5.rule: Produce the shape that is not overlapped by another one and overlaps another shape in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d6.rule: Produce the shape that is overlapped by all other shapes, or is "at the bottom of the stack" in a minimal bounding box.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d7.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while recoloring overlapping pixels in favor of the vertical lines.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d8.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while switching the color of overlapping pixels, meaning if the pixel is currently the color of the horizontal line, it should be recolored to the vertical line.

topbottom3d/topbottom3d9.rule: Reproduce the grid completely, while recoloring all contained shapes to the color of the shape(s) that is overlapping another shape.
